nl.bodyHtml:
Interne links bouwen silo’s of topic clusters: hub-pagina’s + supporting content. Dat helpt SEO én AEO-navigatie.

Bouwplan

  1. Kies 3–7 kernonderwerpen (diensten/regio’s).
  2. Maak of verbeter een hub per onderwerp.
  3. Link vanuit blogs/FAQ’s met beschrijvende ankers.
  4. Vermijd orphan pages zonder inkomende interne links.

Tip: Combineer met contentkalender zodat nieuwe stukken meteen in de cluster hangen.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem of plan een afspraak. Vermeld je domein, doelen (AEO, GEO en/of SEO) en eventuele AI-scanresultaten.

Gerelateerd: Contentkalender; on-page meta.

en.title: Interne linking: how bouw I a sterke silo or topic cluster?
en.excerpt: Out-of-band management (IPMI/iLO/iDRAC): secure network, login, console/ISO, then verify isolation.
en.bodyHtml:
“Interne linking: how bouw I a sterke silo or topic cluster”: BMC/remote console is a separate management path. Keep it off the public internet or behind VPN.

Preparation

  • BMC URL/IP
  • Strong BMC credentials
  • VPN or management VLAN if required

Steps

  1. Reach the BMC only via VPN/management network — not open on 0.0.0.0/0.
  2. Sign in; change default passwords; disable unused services.
  3. Open the HTML5/Java remote console to see the OS as if you were physically there.
  4. For OS install/rescue: mount ISO via Virtual Media; boot from CD/DVD in boot order.
  5. Document MAC, BMC IP and which network segment is for management.
  6. Verify you still have monitoring without BMC, but console when the OS network is down.

Verify

  • Console opens
  • BMC not publicly reachable
  • ISO mount works if needed

Tip: Store BMC passwords in a password manager, separate from OS root.

Note: Outdated BMC firmware is a common attack surface — plan updates.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: Rescue mode, firewall on management VLAN, firmware.
